candidate.role: immutable hidden-side volume and editable-topology starting point; never likeness authority

primary_trace.role: sole primary-view likeness and contour authority

topology_policy.initial: retain the dominant raw v05 component plus every non-trivial component intersecting the literal primary trace; no voxel remesh, quadriflow or automatic retopology

passes.acceptance: captures the unchanged dominant v05 component in the locked reference camera set

passes.primary_goal: turn the existing leading skin into the broad, grounded asymmetric drape indicated by the two literal source strokes
passes.diagnostic_goal: retain the connected raw volume and ground contact while adding only local camera-facing depth

passes.primary_goal: make the source-marked six descending dorsal sac crests read as distinct arcs rather than one shared roof
passes.diagnostic_goal: keep the existing sac volume continuous and never introduce a detached or planar back surface

passes.primary_goal: make six source-marked supports read as thick, tapered grounded arches with preserved negative spaces
passes.diagnostic_goal: preserve existing contact points and do not alter the tail or dorsal masses

composition_rule.execution: Each local pass starts from the same raw-baseline evidence and gets an independent backup, semantic group and review. Passes are compatible but not acceptance dependencies: a failed local review does not prevent the other diagnostic passes.
composition_rule.acceptance: The combined branch remains unaccepted and runtime-export forbidden until a final full-composition audit passes the primary overlay and every diagnostic view. A failed local pass is reverted or superseded only in a new immutable session.

shape_gate.required_review: independent visual review after every deforming pass and one whole-composition audit
rules: primary silhouette must not materially regress
the named pass defect must be visibly reduced in the locked primary view
no diagnostic view may expose a new detached, floating or self-intersecting major form
the result remains unaccepted and non-exportable until the 85-point final contour gate
